gloss: to leave as is; to neglect; to leave unattended

definitions.gloss: to leave as is; to neglect; to leave unattended
definitions.explanation: To leave something or someone alone without taking action, often implying negligence or deliberate inaction. Can refer to physical objects left unattended or problems left unaddressed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{放置|ほうち}→放置：12826_houchi⟧しないで⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please do not leave your luggage unattended.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{放置|ほうち}する⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{悪化|あっか}する→悪化する：18844_akkasuru⟧。
examples.english: If you leave the problem unaddressed, it will get worse.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{長期間|ちょうきかん}→長期間：25696_choukikan⟧⟦{放置|ほうち}→放置：12826_houchi⟧されて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Bicycles have been left abandoned in front of the station for a long time.

notes:
Describes leaving something in its current state without intervention. Often carries a negative nuance of irresponsibility or negligence, though it can also be neutral when deliberate inaction is appropriate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{放置|ほうち}→放置：12826_houchi⟧⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧: abandoned bicycle
- ⟦{放置|ほうち}→放置：12826_houchi⟧⟦{車両|しゃりょう}→車両：05297_sharyou⟧: abandoned vehicle
- ⟦{放置|ほうち}→放置：12826_houchi⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: state of neglect
- ⟦そのまま→そのまま：03322_sonomama⟧{放置|ほうち}する: to leave something as it is

USAGE:
In public signage, ⟦{放置|ほうち}→放置：12826_houchi⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ ("no abandoning") is commonly seen near train stations referring to illegally parked bicycles. The passive form ⟦{放置|ほうち}→放置：12826_houchi⟧されて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes something that has been left in a neglected state.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{無視|むし}する→無視する：17288_mushisuru⟧: to ignore — focuses on deliberately paying no attention, while ⟦{放置|ほうち}→放置：12826_houchi⟧ emphasizes physically or practically leaving something alone
- ⟦ほったらかす→ほったらかす：21542_hottarakasu⟧: to leave unattended (colloquial) — more informal and conversational than {放置|ほうち}する
